            AND = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_baopu event_target:zhx_academy_withdrawn_province = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baopu } }

# Annual AI gate. The eight-percent roll occurs only after all strict
# peace, capacity and plurality conditions have passed.
country_event = {
    id = zhx_academy.300
    title = zhx_academy_lifecycle.300.t
    desc = zhx_academy_lifecycle.300.d
    picture = DIPLOMACY_eventPicture
    hidden = yes
    is_triggered_only = yes
    trigger = { exists = yes }

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_academy_expulsion_campaign }
                OR = {
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_chongli
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_minglun
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_yifa
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_xunming
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_jianai
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_shangtong
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_xuantong
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_baopu
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_miaosuan
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_zhisheng
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_baihe
                    has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_lianheng
                }
            }
            zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                ai = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_has_doctrine = yes
                is_at_war = no
                stability = 2
                adm_power = 100
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_academy_expulsion_campaign }
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_academy_expulsion_cooldown }
                zhx_academy_has_two_unprotected_school_types = yes
            }
            random = {
                chance = 8
                zhx_academy_begin_random_unprotected_expulsion = yes
            }
        }
    }
    option = { name = OK }
}

# One annual revival scheduler: only the current Tianzi may pass.
country_event = {
    id = zhx_academy.301
    title = zhx_academy_lifecycle.301.t
    desc = zhx_academy_lifecycle.301.d
    picture = DIPLOMACY_eventPicture
    hidden = yes
    is_triggered_only = yes
    trigger = {
        exists = yes
        zhx_is_tianzi = yes
        zhx_academy_has_any_dormant = yes
    }
    immediate = { zhx_academy_attempt_dormant_revivals = yes }
    option = { name = OK }
}
